description: This PHP script handles user authentication, including login attempts, account lockout mechanisms, and session management for a device's web interface. It includes functions for IP address classification and manages login flow for 'mso' and 'admin' users, with security features like failed attempt tracking and account locking.

methods.name: innerIP
methods.description: Determines if the client IP is within the internal network based on server IP and network configuration.

methods.name: get_ips
methods.description: Retrieves IP addresses assigned to a specified network interface.

methods.name: if_type
methods.description: Classifies an IP address as 'lan_ip', 'cm_ip', or 'rg_ip' based on network interface IPs.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Initializes a user session with timeout and session ID, and stores login username.
